effect.u_message: Wyald's Black Dog encampment is marked on your map. Follow the broken cart tracks east or circle through the western quarry. The killing ring lies in the southeast; Wyald appears when you enter it.
Wyald emerges in the final clearing. Read the preparation effect when a heavy attack is winding up; break the line or leave its reach. Retreat is still possible.
Wyald is dead. The local breach is exposed in the northern part of the final clearing. Examine it to close the wound, then examine the sealed mark to claim the relic and recall the next trail.

false_effect.u_message: The local breach is held by its guardian. Defeat the apostle first; if its approach was blocked, clear the final clearing and examine this mark to retry.

effect.u_message: This breach is sealed. New demonic incursions are suppressed only within roughly two overmap tiles of this place. Existing demons, the Brand and armor shadows remain. Examine the closed mark to claim the unique relic.

false_effect.u_message: The seal did not take hold. Step away from its center and examine it again; no completion or reward was recorded.

effect.u_message: You claim the relic from the sealed mark. The gift is issued once for this hunt; check the floor if you cannot carry it. Wear it to receive its effect. The hunt journal preserves the directions.

false_effect.u_message: This closed mark has no second relic to give. Your recorded hunt remains complete.

effect.u_message: Broken orders name Wyald, leader of the Black Dogs. The crossing between worlds diverted his old fate: this is a living apostle, not an echo. His heavy rush needs a clear line. The quarry and side paths leave room to retreat; the tied cage doors offer another passage. A scratched note points toward Rosine's mist-filled valley.
